title: Act: Build SceneView hotspots, asset path map and ActionMenu
summary: Act: Build SceneView hotspots, asset path map and ActionMenu
description: Implement the scene rendering components and replaceable asset map.
acceptance_criteria: Behavior matches the requirement acceptance criteria

preserve: game/src/** engine, systems and state modules unchanged

technical_constraints: Reuse game/src runtime via imports; do not copy it
definition_of_done: Files in code_paths implemented and type-check passes

steps.action: Create a pixel-style SVG 320x180 with rectangles for floor, wall, bed, bookshelf, desk, computer, window and door.
steps.expected: File renders as a bedroom placeholder

steps.action: Export ASSET_PATHS: Record<string,string> = {'scene:bedroom':'/assets/bedroom.svg'} and HOTSPOTS: Record<string,{left:string;top:string;width:string;height:string}> keyed by bed, bookshelf, desk, old-computer, window, door with percentage rectangles.
steps.expected: Changing a value in ASSET_PATHS changes the rendered background

steps.action: Export SceneView({sceneId, title, objects: SceneObjectView[], selectedId, onSelect}) rendering img src=ASSET_PATHS['scene:'+sceneId] and one button per object with aria-label=obj.name, style from HOTSPOTS[obj.id], data-open=String(obj.open), onClick -> onSelect(obj.id).
steps.expected: Each object has a clickable hotspot

steps.action: Export ActionMenu({object, onAction}) rendering object.name, object.description and a button per object.actions with its label calling onAction(object.id, action.id); render null when object is undefined.
steps.expected: Menu lists action labels and calls onAction
